name: Secret Staycation
desc:
While the landlord is away, the foods are having staycation.
Let's try to find them hiding in the house!


I'm currently focusing on the development of a new game, therefor I'm taking a break from updating Secret Staycation.
I appreciate your understanding and thank you for your continued support. 


How to Use the Private Server Functionality:
１・Join the game from a private server.
２・You can move to Hide and Seek or Small Farm maps while staying on the private server.
３・Other users can join by entering the password displayed in the bottom left of the screen.
４・You can access the password entry screen from the padlock icon in the top bar. 


Music Composer: @Nicolas_AP7
